h1.en: Output and distance decide whether the Electric 30 Concrete Pump row fits
h1.zh: 输送量和距离决定电动30型混凝土泵这一行是否合适

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Electric 30 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-30-concrete-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Electric 30; Motor Power 30 kW; Output Capacity 12–15 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³; Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Aggregate 13 Pumping (H / V) 20 m / 60 m; Max. Aggregate Size ≤ 3 cm; Dimensions (L×W×H) 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm; Main Unit Weight 1200 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and Main Unit Weight is 1200 kg. The printed output cell is 12–15 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Aggregate 13 Pumping (H / V) 20 m / 60 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 30 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is ≤ 3 cm. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/electric-30-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volumetric_concrete_mixer. It shows: A Modern Volumetric Concrete Mixer. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动30型混凝土泵列在 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Electric 30; 电机功率 30 kW; 理论输送量 12–15 m³/h; 最大出口压力 20 MPa; 料斗容积 0.3 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m; 13 骨料输送（水平/垂直） 20 m / 60 m; 最大骨料粒径 ≤ 3 cm; 外形尺寸 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm; 整机重量 1200 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm，整机重量是 1200 kg。已印输送量是 12–15 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m；13 骨料输送（水平/垂直） 20 m / 60 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 30 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 ≤ 3 cm。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volumetric_concrete_mixer 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：混凝土搅拌机、搅拌机、混凝土。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 Electric 30; 电机功率 30 kW; 理论输送量 12–15 m³/h; 最大出口压力 20 MPa; 料斗容积 0.3 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m; 13 骨料输送（水平/垂直） 20 m / 60 m; 最大骨料粒径 ≤ 3 cm; 外形尺寸 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm; 整机重量 1200 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 12–15 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Aggregate 13 Pumping (H / V) 20 m / 60 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 30 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is ≤ 3 cm. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 12–15 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m；13 骨料输送（水平/垂直） 20 m / 60 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 30 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 ≤ 3 cm。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/electric-30-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。
